anomalies.description: A person in a red jacket and helmet enters the store carrying a large white object (possibly a box or bag), approaches the counter, and appears to place or conceal an item on/under the counter while interacting with the seated staff member. The behavior—entering with a bulky item, immediate approach to counter without browsing, and possible concealment—is consistent with shoplifting or fraudulent transaction attempt. No visible payment or legitimate transaction is observed.

original_descriptions.description: A person in a red jacket and helmet enters the store carrying a large white object (possibly a box or bag), approaches the counter, and appears to place or conceal an item on/under the counter while interacting with the seated staff member. The behavior—entering with a bulky item, immediate approach to counter without browsing, and possible concealment—is consistent with shoplifting or fraudulent transaction attempt. No visible payment or legitimate transaction is observed.

A person in a red jacket and helmet is standing at the counter interacting with a seated employee; however, their posture—leaning forward, hands near the counter edge, and holding a white bag close to the body—suggests possible concealment of merchandise. The individual does not appear to be making a standard purchase (no visible payment, no item exchange), and the behavior is consistent with shoplifting: concealing items in a bag while engaging the clerk to distract or avoid suspicion. No overt violence or theft is visible, but the context and actions are highly suspicious for shoplifting.

A person in a red jacket and helmet stands at the counter while two other individuals enter the store and move quickly toward the exit without interacting with staff or making purchases; their rapid, coordinated movement and lack of engagement suggest possible shoplifting or preparation for theft. One of the newcomers appears to be carrying a bag and moves directly past the counter toward the door, consistent with concealment and exit behavior.

No visible payment or legitimate transaction is observed.

A person in a red jacket and helmet is standing at the counter interacting with a seated employee; however, their posture—leaning forward, hands near the counter edge, and holding a white bag close to the body—suggests possible concealment of merchandise. The individual does not appear to be making a standard purchase (no visible payment, no item exchange), and the behavior is consistent with shoplifting: concealing items in a bag while engaging the clerk to distract or avoid suspicion. No overt violence or theft is visible, but the context and actions are highly suspicious for shoplifting.

A person in a red jacket and helmet stands at the counter while two other individuals enter the store and move quickly toward the exit without interacting with staff or making purchases; their rapid, coordinated movement and lack of engagement suggest possible shoplifting or preparation for theft. One of the newcomers appears to be carrying a bag and moves directly past the counter toward the door, consistent with concealment and exit behavior.
